overview.description: The GraniteShares 2x Long SK Hynix Daily ETF (SKUU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of SK Hynix Inc. (NASDAQ: SKHY) stock. SKUU was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by GraniteShares.
